- Limits: the code is uncommitted, so delivery identity rests on the file hashes above. `regression-review.json` lists single-character path entries (a string appears to have been split into characters); this does not change the result because no verified fixes exist, but the path list is imprecise. The structural validators do not prove semantic truth. No commit, push, PR or archive was performed.
